description: The Reviewers (shared study files) page, plus the RLS integration test pass across all new tables and the final accessibility/theme sweep. Grounded in design.md FR-5.*, OD-5, Data layer -> useReviewers + createReviewer/deleteReviewer, Components -> Reviewers, Testability, and SETUP.md updates. Depends on FEAT-001 (tables/storage policies/publication), FEAT-002 (storage fns, types), FEAT-003 (nav shell + ReviewersPage slot); the RLS pass covers tables from FEAT-001/004/005 too so it runs last.
steps: Create src/data/useReviewers.ts: useRealtimeTable<ReviewerRow, Reviewer>('reviewers', rowToReviewer) with the uploader-name embed selecting name ONLY (never profiles(*)/email).

Extend src/data/mutations.ts: createReviewer(input) — generate id with crypto.randomUUID() BEFORE upload, build `{uploader_id}/{id}/{safeName}` via buildStoragePath, upload to the 'reviewers' bucket, then insert the row WITH that explicit id and storage_path; if upload fails insert nothing; if insert fails after a successful upload, remove the just-uploaded object. deleteReviewer(id, storagePath) — remove the storage object FIRST (treating storage-not-found as success/idempotent), then delete the row (RLS: owner or officer); if the object remove fails, abort before deleting the row.

Create src/components/ReviewerUploadDialog.tsx: title (required), subject <select> (required), optional description, a single file validated by validateFile(REVIEWER_MIME, REVIEWER_MAX) with the INDETERMINATE 'Uploading…' indicator (spinner + disabled submit, no percent bar); submit via createReviewer; shared Modal.

Create src/components/ReviewerCard.tsx + src/components/ReviewerGrid.tsx: a responsive card grid showing title, subject, uploader name, upload date, file-type icon + human-readable size, and a Download button that calls signedUrlFor('reviewers', path, { download: file_name }) and navigates to the returned URL (Storage sets Content-Disposition; do NOT rely on the anchor download attribute). Grid supports filter by subject <select>, search by title (text), sort by newest; an empty state; and a shared Modal confirm dialog before delete (shown for owner or officer; RLS is the real gate).

Replace the FEAT-003 placeholder src/components/ReviewersPage.tsx with the real gated page: SignInGate when signed out; loading/empty/error states; the upload entry (opens ReviewerUploadDialog in Modal) available to any signed-in user.

Extend src/__tests__/rls.integration.test.ts (skip-with-reason when env absent) with cases per design.md Testability + the acceptance criteria: anon denied read/write on task_completions/absence tables/reviewers; member denied event write, officer allowed (AC1/2); member own-row completion insert/delete ok and cross-user denied, tasks.status untouched (AC3); member reads own absence, a SECOND member denied that request AND its attachment AND a guessed storage path, officer reads both (AC7); member cannot insert an attachment object under another member's folder / a non-existent request / an acknowledged own request, but can under a still-pending own request (ea_insert gate); member cannot delete the attachment row OR the storage object once not pending (aa_delete + ea_delete_own pending gate), can while pending (AC9); any authenticated reviewer download ok, anon denied, non-owner delete denied except officer (AC11/12); the pending-count query returns the right count (AC10). Add the new env vars (second member, seeded pending request/attachment ids) and update SETUP.md section 7 with them + manual curl equivalents.

Final verification + a11y/theme pass: run the full gate (typecheck, lint, test, build) and fix any failures. Manual sweep per design.md Testability -> A11y/theme: keyboard traversal of Nav (aria-current), calendar day cells (Enter/Space + visible --focus-ring), forms, and the delete-confirm Modal (focus trap); sr-only labels for completion/status/assessment badges; render in light and dark; confirm palette-ext-aa.test.ts is green as the AA backbone (AC14). Record any live-only verification left to the convergence/finalize steps in findings.
Clean up any temporary files created during verification.
acceptance_criteria: A signed-out visitor sees SignInGate on the Reviewers page; any signed-in user can upload a reviewer and download any reviewer; the download forces a save with the correct filename cross-origin via the SDK download option.
A non-owner cannot delete another user's reviewer except an officer; the confirm Modal appears before delete; createReviewer/deleteReviewer leave no orphaned object or row on partial failure.
The reviewers grid supports subject filter, title search, newest sort, and an empty state.

The RLS integration suite contains cases for every new table and every acceptance criterion (AC1-AC3, AC7-AC12) and either passes against a live project with 0003 + buckets applied or skips with a printed reason locally.
The full gate (typecheck, lint, test, build) passes and palette-ext-aa.test.ts is green.
verification: Run `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run test`, and `npm run build` and confirm all four succeed; palette-ext-aa.test.ts passes.

Confirm the RLS integration suite still skips cleanly with a reason when the live env is unset (no new non-skipped failures); with the SETUP.md section 7 env set against a live project with 0003 + buckets applied, confirm every new case is green (AC13).
Confirm no temporary files remain (git status is clean apart from intended changes).
findings:
Reviewers page + the RLS integration pass + the a11y/theme sweep landed. Full gate green: typecheck 0 errors; lint 0 errors (only the 3 pre-existing react-refresh WARNINGS in NavProvider/SessionProvider/ThemeProvider, untouched); test 168 passed / 22 skipped (was 9 skipped — the +13 are the new RLS extension cases skipping cleanly with a printed reason, no live backend); build OK. palette-ext-aa.test.ts green (18). No new runtime dep. git status clean apart from intended changes (no temp files).

New files:
- src/data/useReviewers.ts — useRealtimeTable<ReviewerRow,Reviewer>('reviewers', rowToReviewer, pollMs, REVIEWER_SELECT). reviewers IS realtime-published (OD-4) so new uploads appear live on signed-in clients; anon receives nothing (no grant/policy). Uploader name resolved via the name-ONLY embed REVIEWER_SELECT='*, uploader:profiles!reviewers_uploader_id_fkey(name)' (never profiles(*)/email). Note: the Realtime INSERT payload does NOT carry the embed, so a freshly streamed row has uploaderName undefined (card shows 'Unknown') until the next fetch (focus/poll) fills it — acceptable.
- src/components/ReviewerUploadDialog.tsx — title (req 1-200), subject <select> (REQUIRED), optional description, SINGLE file via validateFile(REVIEWER_MIME, REVIEWER_MAX); INDETERMINATE 'Uploading…' spinner + disabled submit (no percent bar). Generates id=crypto.randomUUID() BEFORE upload, path via buildStoragePath; submits createReviewer. Shared Modal; file input aria-labelledby.
- src/components/ReviewerCard.tsx — title/subject/uploader name/upload date/file-type icon+human size/Download. Download = signedUrlFor('reviewers', path, { download: fileName }) then window.location.assign(url) (Storage sets Content-Disposition; NOT the anchor download attr). Delete shown for owner-or-officer (RLS is the real gate) behind a shared-Modal confirm (ignores scrim/Esc while deleting). Download/Delete buttons carry aria-label with the title. formatSize/formatDate helpers local.
- src/components/ReviewerGrid.tsx — responsive CSS-grid (auto-fill minmax 16rem); subject <select> filter + title search (case-insensitive) + newest sort (created_at desc, null last); contextual empty state ('none uploaded yet' vs 'none match your filters').

Modified:
- src/components/ReviewersPage.tsx — real gated page (SignInGate when signed out; the DB also denies anon on reviewers). Signed-in: 'Upload a reviewer' button (opens ReviewerUploadDialog in Modal, any signed-in user), loading/error states (status/retry), ReviewerGrid owns the empty state.
- src/data/mutations.ts — createReviewer(input) (upload-then-insert, orphan-safe: upload first; on upload fail insert nothing; insert row WITH explicit id+storage_path; if insert fails after upload, remove the just-uploaded object) and deleteReviewer(id, storagePath) (remove OBJECT first — storage not-found treated as idempotent success via /not.?found/i; abort before deleting the row on any other storage error; then delete the row). Same classify/MutationResult contract, trust RLS.
- src/data/useRealtimeTable.ts — ADDED an optional `select` param (default '*') to BOTH useRealtimeTable and useRealtimeTableKeyed, threaded into the fetch/poll .select() and the fetchAll dep array. Purely additive — all existing callers use the '*' default so base id-keyed behavior and tests are UNCHANGED. This is how useReviewers carries its uploader embed.
- src/__tests__/rls.integration.test.ts — added a SECOND skip-with-reason describe (describeExt) gated on the 0003 fixtures (RLS_TEST_MEMBER2_EMAIL/_PASSWORD, RLS_TEST_ABSENCE_REQUEST_ID, RLS_TEST_ABSENCE_ATTACHMENT_ID) in ADDITION to the base env. It skips independently with its own printed reason when only the base env is set (so the base role suite still runs). 13 cases covering: anon denied/empty read + rejected insert on task_completions/absence tables/reviewers; member event write denied + officer allowed (AC1/2); member own-row completion insert/delete ok, cross-user denied, tasks.status untouched (AC3); member reads own absence, 2nd member denied the request AND the attachment row AND a guessed storage mint, officer reads both (AC7); ea_insert denied under another's folder / non-existent request / acknowledged own request, allowed under pending own; aa_delete + ea_delete_own denied once not pending (AC9); any authenticated reviewer read ok + anon denied, non-owner delete denied + officer allowed (AC11/12); officer pending-count exact >=1 (AC10). afterAll restores the seeded request to pending for re-runnability.
- SETUP.md section 7 — added an 'Extension (0003) cases — manual curl' subsection with REST + storage curl equivalents for every new case (anon-denied, event write, self-only completion, absence privacy incl. guessed signed-URL mint, ea_insert gate, pending-only delete, pending-count via Prefer: count=exact header, reviewer read/delete). The env-var block was already added by FEAT-001.

A11y/theme sweep (manual, per design Testability): all new UI uses ONLY theme tokens (--surface/--border/--text/--muted/--accent/--accent-contrast/--danger/--danger-contrast/--bg/--radius) in both modes — no hardcoded colors; file-type/spinner icons are aria-hidden decorative with text carrying meaning. Every interactive element is a real <button>/<input>/<select> inheriting the global --focus-ring (:focus-visible in base.css). The upload dialog and the delete-confirm both use the shared Modal (focus trap + Esc + focus restore). Download/Delete buttons disambiguated with per-card aria-label.

LIVE-ONLY VERIFICATION left to the convergence/finalize steps (cannot run in this worktree — no live backend): apply 0003 + create the two PRIVATE buckets (SETUP.md) with the exact MIME/size config, seed a second member + a pending absence request + attachment, set the RLS_TEST_* (base + 0003) env, then `npm run test` and confirm all 22 now-skipped RLS cases (9 base + 13 extension) are GREEN (AC13). Also the manual storage checks in design Testability (oversize/wrong-type upload rejected by the bucket config — AC8-equivalent; a signed URL expiring after 60s). These are inherently live-backend assertions.
